About TasteTrail.

Every trip has a flavour. TasteTrail lets you pin each dish you taste on a world map, write down where you had it and how it made you feel, and come back to your personal food atlas anytime.

Click anywhere on the map, pick an emoji, add a note, done. Your dishes and the countries you have tasted are always one click away.
